fields.label: Consumer Doctype
fields.description: Doctype of the voucher that absorbed this slice of the parent's carry-forward. 'VECRM Expense Voucher' today; Data rather than Link so a Travel voucher can absorb later without a schema change.

fields.label: Consumer Voucher
fields.description: The voucher that absorbed this amount, e.g. 'VE/EV/00092/26-27'.

fields.label: Amount Consumed (Rs)
fields.description: Rupees drawn from the parent voucher's carry_forward_amount by this consumer. outstanding = parent.carry_forward_amount - SUM(amount) across these rows. Never negative; a reversal is a new row on a corrective voucher, never an edit of this one.

fields.label: Settled At
fields.description: When the consumption was recorded. Ruling B (S75) rows carry the consumer's approved_at; S132 rows carry the payout-run timestamp.

fields.label: Settled By
fields.description: Actor who caused the consumption. Ruling B rows carry the approver; S132 rows carry the Accounts user who ran the cycle settlement.

fields.label: Period Key
fields.description: Half-month key of the consuming voucher, e.g. '2026-08-H2'. Informational: lets Accounts see which payout cycle absorbed the carry.
